round_interpretation: Round one increased fixed-reference hypervolume by 6.65%. Removing rank created a seven-input front with higher Sharpe and lower NLL but lower IC. Adding lag to the ranked parent improved density while hurting ranking and Sharpe. HY-z and curve removal were strongly harmful in the original compact context. Round two uses the rank-free front to test local simplification, conditional lag rescue, alternative credit/inflation/curve representations, and small volatility/flow transfers. These are conditional hypotheses, not an imposed universal core.
default_expected_tradeoff: Report all three objectives and paired three-seed effects, plus coverage and width; input count and interval width are descriptive, not objectives.
default_falsification: A dominated result does not support this simplification or transfer. Preserve genuine new objective tradeoffs; three seeds do not supply independent economic replication.

candidates.name: rank_free_without_six_month_momentum
candidates.hypothesis: Rank removal may change the incremental value of six-month momentum; test the interaction instead of transferring the ranked-parent ablation.

candidates.name: rank_free_without_trend_slope
candidates.hypothesis: The two momentum horizons may suffice when global rank is absent.

candidates.name: rank_free_without_skip_momentum
candidates.hypothesis: Re-test corrected skip momentum in the rank-free context; a failure establishes context-specific need, not a universal rule.

candidates.name: rank_free_plus_lag
candidates.hypothesis: Lag's density benefit may coexist with the rank-free parent's stronger Sharpe rather than reproducing its ranked-parent ranking loss.

candidates.name: rank_free_without_credit_change
candidates.hypothesis: The normalized credit state may suffice after rank removal, although the same removal was harmful in the ranked context.

candidates.name: rank_free_credit_level_instead_of_change
candidates.hypothesis: Level plus normalized state may represent repaired credit conditions better than change plus normalized state.

candidates.name: rank_free_credit_level_instead_of_zscore
candidates.hypothesis: Distinguish the need for genuine credit information from dependence on its rolling z-score representation.

candidates.name: rank_free_monthly_instead_of_annual_inflation
candidates.hypothesis: Monthly inflation may preserve useful macro state with a more responsive signal; latest-vintage/staleness caveats remain unchanged.

candidates.name: rank_free_nominal_yield_instead_of_curve
candidates.hypothesis: Separate yield-level information from curve shape rather than inferring a universal curve feature from one context.

candidates.name: rank_free_without_six_month_momentum_plus_lag
candidates.hypothesis: Recent-return lag could replace one intermediate momentum horizon rather than simply increasing model dimension.

candidates.name: rank_free_plus_local_volatility
candidates.hypothesis: Task-local volatility may be more useful after rank removal, despite not improving the ranked parent's frontier.

candidates.name: rank_free_plus_market_flow
candidates.hypothesis: A single market-activity signal may complement compact credit/curve state without importing a large risk block.
